mapper.sql: SELECT t.leave_req_id, t.leave_req_no, t.employee_id, t.employee_name, t.employee_no, t.dept_id, t.dept_name, t.leave_type, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.leave_days, t.reason, t.attachment_url, t.audit_status, t.audit_by, t.audit_time, t.audit_remark, t.status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, b.remaining_days, b.total_days, b.used_days FROM biz_hr_leave_request t LEFT JOIN biz_hr_leave_balance b ON b.employee_id = t.employee_id AND b.leave_type = t.leave_type AND b.year = YEAR(NOW()) AND (b.del_flag IS NULL OR b.del_flag = '0')
mapper.delete: UPDATE biz_hr_leave_request SET del_flag = '2' WHERE leave_req_id = #{leaveReqId}
UPDATE biz_hr_leave_request SET del_flag = '2' WHERE leave_req_id IN #{leaveReqId}
